name: markdown-frontend
body: The markdown document frontend: a new Rust standalone binary under `src/mdlib`, built by build.rs and staged as `mdfrontend` (the bare-binary convention like pyfrontend/csharpfrontend/rustfrontend). It discovers `.md` and `.markdown` sources (`.mdx` is out), emits each file as a File (FQN = the absolute path) under a directory-based Module (`md.<absolute-path>`), and each heading as a Struct section symbol nested by heading level, applying the pinned slug rule (requirements.constraint.markdown-slug-rule) and the section FQN scheme (requirements.requirement.markdown-sections-as-symbols). It emits no links: link references becoming graph edges are DEFERRED — a later feature, out of scope (requirements.note.markdown-links-deferred) — so there is no synthesized document-root section and a heading-less document yields only its File. Its source does not exist yet and is not in the scanned graph, so its `implemented-by` anchors are the planned Implementation nodes `rust.mdfrontend` (Module) and `rust.mdfrontend.main` (Function) — graded Pending until the branch re-scan realizes them, the same planned-anchor state as solution.component.js-ts-frontend and solution.component.rust-manifest-discovery.
